name: Rankety
tagline: AI-powered SEO audit and checker for data-driven decisions
description: Rankety is an AI-powered SEO audit and checker tool. Enter a website URL to run a comprehensive SEO audit in about 60 seconds. It reviews technical issues, content quality, user experience, and mobile-friendliness, with 120+ checks and prioritized, actionable recommendations. The platform includes 15+ SEO tools, including SEO Audit, On-Page SEO Checker, Technical SEO Audit, Competitor Analysis, Local SEO, Sitemap Validator, Hreflang Checker, Schema Markup, E-commerce SEO Audit, Content Quality Checker, White-Label SEO, Programmatic SEO, GEO Intelligence, and Maps Intelligence. Reports can be exported as PDF or Markdown, and the tools and reports are available in 11 languages. Free trial with 30 welcome credits and no credit card required. Pay-as-you-go credit packages: Starter $9 (230 credits), Growth $29 (920 credits), Pro $79 (2,875 credits), and Agency $199 (8,625 credits, includes white-label PDF reports). Credits never expire. A full SEO audit uses 6 credits; GEO Intelligence uses 10 credits.
